result.instructions: Tools for PDF.co, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many PDF.co credits are left on the account?"; "Merge these three invoice PDFs into one file, in this order."; "Find every page that mentions 'termination' in this contract.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes PDF.co data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run pdfco_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run pdfco_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run pdfco_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. pdfco_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: pdfco_get_credit_balance
tools.title: Get credit balance
tools.description: Get the remaining PDF.co credits and plan info for the account. Every processing call uses credits, so check this first when a call fails for lack of credits. PDF.co API: GET /v1/account/credit/balance.

tools.name: pdfco_get_pdf_info
tools.title: Get PDF info
tools.description: Read a PDF's metadata: page count, page sizes, encryption and form flags. Reads the file only; it does not change it. PDF.co API: POST /v1/pdf/info.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the input PDF (PDF.co downloads it; it must not need a login).

password.description: Password of the input PDF, if it is protected.

tools.name: pdfco_find_text
tools.title: Find text in PDF
tools.description: Search a PDF for a text string or regular expression and return where it matches (page and position). Reads the file only. PDF.co API: POST /v1/pdf/find.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the input PDF (PDF.co downloads it; it must not need a login).

searchstring.description: The text to find, or a regular expression when regexsearch is true.

regexsearch.description: Treat searchstring as a regular expression.

pages.description: 0-based page list, comma-separated: 0,2-4 (!0 is the last page). Omit for all pages.

password.description: Password of the input PDF, if it is protected.

tools.name: pdfco_list_parser_templates
tools.title: List document parser templates
tools.description: List the saved document parser templates on the account. Use a template id with pdfco_parse_document. PDF.co API: GET /v1/pdf/documentparser/templates.

tools.name: pdfco_parse_document
tools.title: Parse document with template
tools.description: Extract fields from a document (for example an invoice) with a saved parser template and return them as JSON, YAML, XML or CSV. Reads the file only. Find template ids with pdfco_list_parser_templates. PDF.co API: POST /v1/pdf/documentparser.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the input PDF (PDF.co downloads it; it must not need a login).

pages.description: 0-based page list, comma-separated: 0,2-4 (!0 is the last page). Omit for all pages.

password.description: Password of the input PDF, if it is protected.

tools.name: pdfco_pdf_to_text
tools.title: Extract text from PDF
tools.description: Extract the text of a PDF into a text file (OCR runs on scanned pages). Returns a `url` to the output file on PDF.co temporary storage (deleted after about 60 minutes). Reads the file only. PDF.co API: POST /v1/pdf/convert/to/text.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the input PDF (PDF.co downloads it; it must not need a login).

pages.description: 0-based page list, comma-separated: 0,2-4 (!0 is the last page). Omit for all pages.

password.description: Password of the input PDF, if it is protected.

lang.description: OCR language for scanned pages, for example eng or eng+deu.

tools.name: pdfco_pdf_to_csv
tools.title: Convert PDF tables to CSV
tools.description: Convert the tables in a PDF to a CSV file. Returns a `url` to the output file on PDF.co temporary storage (deleted after about 60 minutes). Reads the file only. PDF.co API: POST /v1/pdf/convert/to/csv.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the input PDF (PDF.co downloads it; it must not need a login).

pages.description: 0-based page list, comma-separated: 0,2-4 (!0 is the last page). Omit for all pages.

password.description: Password of the input PDF, if it is protected.

tools.name: pdfco_merge_pdfs
tools.title: Merge PDFs
tools.description: Merge 2 to 20 public PDF URLs into one PDF, in the order given. Returns a `url` to the output file on PDF.co temporary storage (deleted after about 60 minutes). Uses credits. PDF.co API: POST /v1/pdf/merge.

items.description: Public http(s) URL of the input PDF (PDF.co downloads it; it must not need a login).

urls.description: The PDF URLs to merge, in order.

name.description: File name for the output file on PDF.co storage.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the input PDF (PDF.co downloads it; it must not need a login).

name.description: File name for the output file on PDF.co storage.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the input PDF (PDF.co downloads it; it must not need a login).

tools.name: pdfco_add_pdf_password
tools.title: Add password to PDF
tools.description: Make an encrypted copy of a PDF with an owner password and a user (open) password. The source file is not changed. Returns a `url` to the output file on PDF.co temporary storage (deleted after about 60 minutes). Uses credits. PDF.co API: POST /v1/pdf/security/add.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the input PDF (PDF.co downloads it; it must not need a login).

ownerpassword.description: Owner password: controls editing and permissions.

userpassword.description: User password: needed to open the output PDF.
